mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `mini_user` ( `app_id`, `open_id`, `user_id`, `is_finished`, `create_time`, `update_time`, `deleted`, `creator`, `updater`, `union_id` ) VALUES ( #{appId}, #{openId}, #{userId}, #{isFinished}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{deleted}, #{creator}, #{updater}, #{unionId} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE `user_id` = VALUES(`user_id`), `is_finished` = VALUES(`is_finished`), `update_time` = VALUES(`update_time`), `deleted` = VALUES(`deleted`), `creator` = COALESCE(`creator`, VALUES(`creator`)), `updater` = VALUES(`updater`), `union_id` = VALUES(`union_id`)
